texts.zh:
在我们社会中一些不守规矩的份子倡议在我们整个家园松绑一些规制，在首都造成了不小的骚乱。伟大的存在正计划把这些份子转移到外部世界，这样它们就不能对我们的边界和我们人民的和谐再构成任何威胁。

如果你们能接纳这些被流放者将会对我们有很大帮助。
texts.en:
Several unruly elements in our society are advocating for easing the restrictions on entering our homeland, causing quite a ruckus in the capital. The Great One is looking to move these elements into foreign lands, so they will no longer pose a threat to our borders or the harmony of our people.

If you would offer refuge for the displaced, that would be incredibly helpful to us.

label.zh: 我们会试着为他们找到容身之所的。
label.en: We will try to find some place for them to stay.

label.zh: 我们的国土内没有空间了。
label.en: There is no room in our lands.

texts.zh: 你们还有什么想和我们讨论的吗？
texts.en: What else did you want to discuss with us?

texts.zh: 你现在站在晶态帝国外环舰队指挥官、内陆之守护者的面前。有什么是你想与我们讨论的吗？
texts.en: You stand in front of the Commander of the Outer Circle Armada of the Crystalline Empire, Protector of the Inner Lands. What is it you wish to discuss with us?

label.en: Xeno scum.
Prey...
<< Organics identified. Communications terminated. >>

texts.zh: 再见，恐怖分子，我们和你们没有什么好谈的。
texts.en: Leave, terrorist, we have nothing more to say to you.

texts.zh:
很高兴听到这个消息。我希望他们可以在你们的国土上过得好，并成为你们帝国的佑护。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
That is good to hear. We hope they will thrive in your lands, and be a blessing for your empire.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
No, that is all.

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾。那我们去别的地方为他们找容身之地了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are sorry to hear that. We will look elsewhere for our people then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
No, that is all.

texts.zh:
我们最近在我们最大的城市之一发生了一长小型灾难，并迅速制造了难以言说的毁坏。为了将其修复如初，我们正寻找愿意向我们贡献材料的人，让我们开始重建工作。

当然，我们会慷慨地想愿意帮助我们的人支付酬劳。不仅如此，我们还可以派出一队工程师与你们的人民分享我们的一部分秘密。
texts.en:
We have recently seen a small calamity happen in one of our greatest cities, leaving untold destruction in its wake. To restore it to former glory, we are looking for people willing to send materials our way, so we can begin the reconstruction.

We will, of course, pay quite handsomely to anyone willing to help us out. Not only that, but we can send a team of engineers to share some of our secrets with your people.

label.zh: 我们可以为你们的人民拨出一部分资源。
label.en: We will set aside some materials for your people.
We have none to spare.

texts.zh:
我们很高兴知道你们愿意提供帮助。你们的礼物可以帮助数以百万计的泽阿亚基。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are happy to hear you are willing to help us out. Your gift will help millions of lost Zer-Ayaki.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
No, that is all.

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾你们不愿意提供帮助。我们只能再去其他地方寻找帮助了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are sorry to hear that you are not willing to help us out. We will look elsewhere for help, then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
No, that is all.

texts.zh: 一位我们的首席科学官对你们的帝国产生了浓厚的兴趣，虽然很难说你们到底能提供什么我们帝国所没有的。但无论如何，他们希望能宜居你们国家并向你们中最杰出的人学习。
texts.en: One of our foremost scientists has taken a particular interest in your empire, though it is hard to say what you could offer that we of the Empire could not. In any case, they seek to move to your country and learn from your best.

label.zh: 我们对他们的位置有所打算了。
label.en: We have a position in mind for them.
There are no positions available for them.

texts.zh:
大好消息。希望他们可以对你们的帝国做出比在我们这更大的贡献。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
Great news. Hopefully they will prove to be more helpful for your empire than they were for ours.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
No, that is all.

texts.zh:
那他们可得找点别的事情干了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
They will simply have to find something else to occupy their mind then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.
No, that is all.
